stories.summary: They helped the G.O.P. avoid more House midterm losses — on top of the advantage they already have from gerrymandering. When Republicans started redrawing congressional maps in the summer of 2025, they hoped to gain enough seats to give the party a chance to hold the House in this year’s midterm elections. That gambit did not come close to working. The Democrats won so overwhelmingly that they easily overcame the G.O.P.’s newly drawn lines. In many cases, Democrats wound up winning the seats that the Republicans targeted. Sometimes, Democrats even gained seats in the very states where Republicans redrew the maps to their advantage.
